title: Toddler with Easter Basket in Sunny Garden, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A toddler in a light sleeveless sunsuit sits barefoot on a stone garden walkway during an Easter morning egg hunt, carefully holding an egg. Beside the child sits a woven wicker basket filled with eggs alongside a decorated metal pail. In the background is a modest clapboard cottage bordered by a rock-lined flowerbed and climbing vines. This candid scene illustrates mid-20th-century American childhood domestic life and springtime holiday rituals.
